overview.title: HyperSIGMA native-SEM and PCA-100 few-shot experiments
overview.what_this_covers: All HyperSIGMA experiments in the 'native semantic (SEM)' and 'PCA-100' families: the native full-band pad-vs-upscale ablation, the SEM-adaptation runs, and the PCA-100 11x11-adapted runs (spatial_only and joint_sem) across Houston, MUUFL and Trento. For every run the report carries the verbatim pretrain/adapt config, metadata, eval config/metadata and full results.json, plus a verified write-up of purpose and design (README claims checked against the actual configs and the code that determines input handling).
overview.common_backbone: HyperSIGMA dual-branch ViT-B (a SpatViT spatial branch + a SpecViT spectral branch), ~180M parameters, loaded from the official HyperSIGMA pretrained checkpoints. In every experiment the two ViT-B transformer bodies are FROZEN; only lightweight, randomly-initialised front-ends / decoders / fusion modules are ever trained (see 'adaptation_modes').

houston.note: Houston2013; spatial branch uses a real PCA 144->100.

native_full_band.description: Off-the-shelf, UN-adapted (frozen) HyperSIGMA used as a feature extractor. A single branch is used at a time (spatial_only OR spectral_only, no SEM fusion). The 11x11 few-shot patch is fit to the backbone's native 64x64 input either by centered zero-PADDING or by bicubic UPSCALING. This is the baseline that the SEM / PCA-100 adaptations are meant to improve on. Ablates pad-vs-upscale x spatial-vs-spectral x {houston,muufl,trento} = 12 evaluations.

native_sem.description: Keeps the native 64x64 geometry (11x11 padded or upscaled to 64x64) but ADAPTS the model with continued MAE using adapt_mode='sem_only': only the SEM (Spatial-Spectral Enhancement Module) + the fused decoder + spectral L1 layer + 2 mask tokens are trained; both ViT bodies, the input projections and the PCA stay frozen. The few-shot feature is the 512-d SEM 'fused' embedding. Tests whether cheaply tuning the fusion module on top of the frozen backbone beats the raw backbone. Houston only; an upscale eval and a pad eval were attempted.

pca100_adapted_11x11.description: The model is ADAPTED to ingest the 11x11 patch NATIVELY (native_geometry=false: the 11x11 patch is reflect-padded to 12x12 and cut by a stride-3 conv into a 4x4 = 16-token grid; pos-embed is interpolated 8x8 -> 4x4) with the spectral dimension compressed to 100 channels. Two adaptation modes are compared: 'spatial_only' (cheap, ~1.1M trainable, 768-d spatial feature) and 'joint_sem' (richer, ~8.4M trainable incl. SEM fusion, 512-d fused feature). Each (dataset x mode) has a separate adapt run that produces a checkpoint, then an eval run that does few-shot on it.

input_geometry_modes.pad_to_64: 11x11 patch centered in a 64x64 zero canvas, fed to the native backbone (used by native_full_band *_pad and native_sem_pad).
input_geometry_modes.upscale_to_64: 11x11 patch bicubically resized to 64x64, fed to the native backbone (used by native_full_band *_upscale and the native_sem upscale run).
input_geometry_modes.native_11x11_adapted: 11x11 reflect-padded to 12x12 -> stride-3 conv -> 4x4 (16) tokens; the model is retrained for this small geometry. Used by ALL pca100 runs. NOTE: the eval_metadata 'input_fit=upscale'/'native_geometry' fields in the pca100 evals are inert defaults and do NOT apply on this path.

spectral_frontend.spectral_branch_full_bands: SpecViT ingests the raw HSI bands (144/64/63).
spectral_frontend.spatial_branch_100ch: SpatViT's patch-embed conv takes 100 input channels. Houston gets a REAL PCA 144->100 (pca_houston_100band.pkl, cumulative explained variance ~1.0). MUUFL (64 bands) and Trento (63 bands) cannot yield 100 PCs, so the pipeline falls back to a parameter-free SpectralResample (1-D linear interpolation) 64->100 / 63->100. 'PCA-100' is therefore a MISNOMER for MUUFL and Trento.

adaptation_modes.none_frozen: native_full_band: no training, frozen backbone, single branch.
adaptation_modes.sem_only: native_sem: trains SEM + fused decoder + spectral L1 + 2 mask tokens only (~8.4M region but most via fusion); both ViT bodies + input proj + PCA frozen.
adaptation_modes.spatial_only: pca100 spatial_only: trains SpatViT patch_embed.proj + pos_embed + deformable sampling_offsets + spat_mask_token + spat_decoder (~1.1M trainable); ViT body frozen; SpecViT and SEM unused.
adaptation_modes.joint_sem: pca100 joint_sem: trains both branch front-ends + mask tokens + per-branch decoders + SEM + fused decoder (~8.45M trainable); both ViT-B bodies frozen (~179.55M). Loss = L_spatial + L_spectral + L_fused.
adaptation_modes.adapt_procedure: Continued masked-autoencoder (MAE) pretraining, token masking ratio 0.75, from the HyperSIGMA pretrained checkpoint. native_sem adapt: ~2000 epochs, batch 64, lr 1.5e-4. pca100 adapt: 2000 epochs, batch 128, lr 1e-5. Seed 42, RTX 4090 throughout.

few_shot_eval_protocol.classifier: Prototypical (class prototype = mean of L2-normalised support features).
few_shot_eval_protocol.n_way: Full label set per dataset (Houston 15, MUUFL 11, Trento 6).
few_shot_eval_protocol.primary_metric: euclidean (the top-level overall accuracy in results.json equals the euclidean result)
few_shot_eval_protocol.feature_normalization: L2 (applied for cosine; features mean-pooled from the backbone)
few_shot_eval_protocol.metrics_reported: Overall Accuracy (OA), Average Accuracy (AA), Kappa, per-class accuracy, per-episode arrays; balanced n_query => OA == AA.

key_observations: Spatial features >> spectral features for few-shot everywhere; euclidean > cosine consistently.
Houston: PCA-100 11x11-adapted (joint_sem 67.5% / spatial_only 66.4% euclidean OA) beats the un-adapted native spatial baseline (pad 59.3% / upscale 61.1%) and far beats native_sem pad (45.3%).
Trento: un-adapted native spatial UPSCALE (91.1%) actually edges out the PCA-100 adapted runs (joint_sem 87.2% / spatial_only 86.0%); adaptation did not help Trento here.
joint_sem (SEM fusion, 512-d) slightly beats spatial_only (768-d) on Houston and Trento; MUUFL joint_sem was never evaluated (adapt killed at 1050/2000 epochs).

primary_results_at_a_glance.metric: euclidean overall accuracy (%) / cosine in parentheses
primary_results_at_a_glance.note: Verbatim per-run numbers (with std and 95% CI) are in results_summary_table and in each experiment's raw results.json.

analysis.name: hypersigma_native_ablation_run1
analysis.purpose: Native-geometry ablation: evaluate the released HyperSIGMA SpatViT-B and SpecViT-B encoders, UNADAPTED and frozen, at their pretrained input geometry (SpatViT 64x64/patch-8/100-channel; SpecViT 64x64) on 11x11 few-shot patches. The 11x11 patch is fit up to the native 64x64 input by either zero-PADDING (centered) or bicubic UPSCALING. Spatial and spectral branches are evaluated separately (single-branch, no SEM fusion) across houston/muufl/trento to isolate which input-fit strategy best matches each encoder's pretraining geometry.

Created 2026-06-06T22:56:17, git_sha 08b592987d56d1d94aace857ba6a0d200215c7ae, base config None.
analysis.readme_vs_actual: CONFIRMED by configs/logs: native_geometry=true, adapted_checkpoint='none' (unadapted), single-branch (mode=spat_pool / spec_pool, no SEM), input_fit in {pad,upscale}, SpatViT loads at (768,100,8,8)/pos_embed(1,64,768)=64x64 patch-8, SpecViT spat_map(768,4096)=64x64 / pos_embed(1,100,768), all 12 evals status=complete, git_sha matches README. CLARIFICATION on '100ch': the README's '100ch' is the SpatViT input-CHANNEL count (pretrained patch_embed.proj in_chans=100), NOT raw HSI bands and NOT spatial size. To reach 100 channels the SPATIAL branch applies a 144->100 PCA on Houston (explained variance 1.0000) and a SpectralResample 64->100 (MUUFL) / 63->100 (Trento). So the spatial branch is NOT 'full band' — it is dimensionality-mapped to 100. The README does not mention this PCA/resample front-end. The SPECTRAL branch does feed raw bands (144/64/63, no spectral PCA), consistent with 'full band'. The eval distance_metric is 'euclidean' (primary), but each results.json also stores a parallel 'cosine' block; the audit prompt assumed cosine primary -- actual primary is euclidean.

design_choices.backbone: HyperSIGMA ViT-B per branch: SpatViT_fusion_patch (embed_dim=768, depth=12, heads=12) and SpectralVisionTransformer/SpecViT_fusion (embed_dim=768, depth=12, heads=12, NUM_TOKENS=100). Encoders frozen (freeze_body=True); evaluated one branch at a time (no SEM fusion).
design_choices.native_model_input_size: 64x64 for BOTH branches. SpatViT: native_spat_img_size=64, patch=8 -> 8x8=64 patches (models/hypersigma/hypersigma_dual.py:84-86; spat_vit_branch.py:128-134; log: patch_embed.proj (768,100,8,8), pos_embed (1,64,768), feature stage 1x1). SpecViT: native_spec_img_size=64 -> spat_map Linear(4096=64*64, 768) (hypersigma_dual.py:87; spec_vit_branch.py:125-151; log: spat_map (768,4096), pos_embed (1,100,768)).
design_choices.pad_target: 11x11 zero-padded (constant 0), centered, up to 64x64 (models/hypersigma/_input_fit.py:49-66; pad_anchor='center'). Applied in SpatViTBranch.forward / SpecViTBranch.forward via fit_input(x, 64, 'pad').
design_choices.upscale_target: 11x11 bicubic-interpolated (align_corners=False) up to 64x64 (models/hypersigma/_input_fit.py:42-47; interp_mode='bicubic'). Applied via fit_input(x, 64, 'upscale').
design_choices.pca_components: Branch-dependent. SPECTRAL branch: none (raw bands fed to SpecViT, in_chans=144/64/63; resampled to 100 spectral TOKENS internally via AdaptiveAvgPool1d). SPATIAL branch: mapped to the 100-channel pretrained SpatViT width -- Houston via 144->100 PCA (PCAPreprocessor, explained variance 1.0000, then PCAStandardize from pca_houston_100band_stats.pkl); MUUFL 64->100 and Trento 63->100 via SpectralResample (parameterless linear band-axis interpolation, no PCA pickle). Source: hypersigma_dual.py:218-260, preprocessing.py:153-186, eval logs.
design_choices.feature_dim: 768 for both branches. spat_pool = adaptive_avg_pool2d(last SpatViT FPN stage [B,768,1,1]) -> [B,768]; spec_pool = mean over 100 SpecViT tokens of last stage [B,100,768] -> [B,768]. Both L2-normalized (models/hypersigma/hypersigma_cosine.py:69-107).

few_shot.feature_normalization: L2-normalized 768-d features (always, in HyperSIGMACosine.forward_features). Cosine metric: dot product * temperature 10.0 on the already-unit features; Euclidean metric: -||q-proto||^2 (torch.cdist) on the same L2-normalized features (so euclidean is effectively on the unit sphere). Prototype = mean of support features (prototype_mode='mean_features'). No CPEA/projection head -- adapt_embeddings is a pass-through (hypersigma_cosine.py:109-117).

design_choices.other_notes: n_way is NOT in eval_config; it defaults to all classes for the dataset (C-way) via PatchedEpisodeSampler (evaluate_hypersigma_cosine.py: --n-way default None). split='all' (not test). Per-channel min-max [0,1] normalization on HSI before PCA/resample (data/datasets/patched.py:166-179). temperature=10.0. Both cosine+euclidean blocks computed every run from the same features; 'euclidean' is the primary metric promoted to top-level OA/AA/Kappa. No masking (eval only).

(2) The audit brief assumed 'full band, no PCA here' and 'cosine' primary metric; ACTUAL: the SPATIAL branch uses a 144->100 PCA (Houston) or 64/63->100 SpectralResample (MUUFL/Trento) to hit the pretrained 100-channel width, and the primary/headline metric is EUCLIDEAN (each results.json nonetheless reports BOTH cosine and euclidean blocks). group_context.what_is_sem: SEM = Spatial-Spectral Enhancement Module (models/hypersigma/sem.py, class SEM). It is the 4-stage gated fusion block ported from HyperSIGMA's ss_fusion_cls.SSFusionFramework with the downstream classifier removed. For each of num_stages=4 FPN stages it (1) applies a 1x1 Conv2d dimension-reduction spat_dim(768)->dr_dim(128) on the spatial feature map (self.dr[i]), (2) maps the global-pooled spectral token vector [B,num_tokens=100] through an MLP Linear(100,128)+ReLU+Linear(128,128)+Sigmoid to a per-channel gate w_i (self.fc_spec[i]), (3) gates the spatial map: fused_i = (1+w_i)*dr_i, then adaptive-avg-pools to [B,128] and concatenates the 4 stages -> a [B, 4*dr_dim = 512] fused feature (sem.py:67-95). All SEM params are randomly initialized (no upstream checkpoint ships them) and trainable. 'sem' is NOT a separate projection head bolted on at eval; it is the model's intrinsic fusion module. The 'native_sem' family adapt_mode='sem_only': both pretrained ViT bodies + input projections + PCA stay FROZEN and ONLY the fusion path (SEM + fused_decoder + the spectral l1 768->128 projection + two mask tokens) is MAE-tuned (pretrain/hypersigma_mae.py:113-201). The 512-d SEM 'fused' vector is the eval feature for prototype few-shot matching.

Base configs exist for MUUFL and Trento native_sem_pad (configs/pretrain/hypersigma_muufl_adapt_native_sem_pad.yaml, hypersigma_trento_adapt_native_sem_pad.yaml) and the driver scripts/run_native_sem_pad_experiments.sh defaults to DATASETS='houston trento muufl', but NO muufl or trento native_sem experiment directory exists under experiments/ -- only the three Houston dirs. Partial trace: checkpoints/hypersigma_adapted/ contains houston_native_sem_pad (complete: checkpoint_final.pth) and trento_native_sem_pad (INCOMPLETE: only checkpoint_epoch_5/10/20/50.pth + checkpoint.pth, NO checkpoint_final.pth) -- i.e. the Trento pad adaptation was started 2026-06-09 ~15:00 but never finished and was never evaluated. There is NO muufl_native_sem_pad checkpoint dir at all. Also note the UPSCALE adapted checkpoint is NOT in checkpoints/hypersigma_adapted/ (no houston_native_sem dir there); it lives inside experiments/hypersigma_adapt_houston_native_sem_run1/checkpoints/. NET: of the native_sem family, only ONE completed few-shot result exists (Houston PAD); the Houston UPSCALE eval crashed, and Trento/MUUFL pad runs were not completed/evaluated.

All SEM params are randomly initialized (no upstream checkpoint ships them) and trainable. 'sem' is NOT a separate projection head bolted on at eval; it is the model's intrinsic fusion module. The 512-d SEM 'fused' vector is the eval feature for prototype few-shot matching.
